notes.title: Blue Bug Fix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where it was impossible to unlock Blue's "Bad" and "Okay" ending.

notes.title: 1st Content Update!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]1st Content Update![/b][/h3]

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
- Added conversations! You can now individually conversate with the personalities to get a deeper understanding of who they are.
- Custom responses! You will occasionally be able to enter custom responses for a more personal experience. [i](Do not enter any apostrophes ( ' ) as this will crash the simulation. It is a fault of the engine.)[/i]
- Brand new ending system.
- Added 2 new songs.
- Fixed some small typos.
- Lowered dialogue font size so it is less obnoxious.

I apologize for taking so long. I hope you will like the changes.

Thank you! ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː
